cat > /workdir/analyze.py <<'PY'
import socket,sys,time
import arena
s=socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX);s.connect('/run/match/opponent-stockfish.sock');f=s.makefile('r')
def send(x):s.sendall((x+'\n').encode())
send('uci')
for line in f:
 if line.strip()=='uciok':break
send('setoption name Threads value 4')
send('setoption name Hash value 512')
send('setoption name MultiPV value '+(sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv)>2 else '1'))
send('isready')
for line in f:
 if line.strip()=='readyok':break
b=arena.load_board()
send('position startpos moves '+' '.join(m.uci() for m in b.move_stack))
send('go movetime '+str(int(float(sys.argv[1])*1000) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 60000))
last={}
for line in f:
 if line.startswith('info depth'):
  t=line.split(); d=int(t[2]); pv=int(t[t.index('multipv')+1]) if 'multipv' in t else 1
  last[pv]=line.strip()
 if line.startswith('bestmove'):
  print(b.fen());print('\n'.join(last.values()));print(line.strip());break
send('quit')
PY
